scripts.dev: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -- pnpm run start
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dfragon/lib build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --import reflect-metadata --test ".test-dist/test/**/*.test.js" test-support/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify:skills: pnpm run build && node --import reflect-metadata test-support/verify-skill-calculation.mjs
scripts.db:migration:generate: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -- typeorm migration:generate -d dist/database/cli-data-source.js
scripts.db:migration:run: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -- typeorm migration:run -d dist/database/cli-data-source.js
scripts.db:migration:revert: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -- typeorm migration:revert -d dist/database/cli-data-source.js
scripts.db:migration:show: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -- typeorm migration:show -d dist/database/cli-data-source.js
